instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["height"] - 0.006) < 0.001 and abs(c["yaw"] - 1.329) < 0.01:
        best_candidate = c
        break
grasp(best_candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
best_spot = None
for s in spots:
    if abs(s["object_long_axis_yaw"] - 1.329) < 0.01:
        best_spot = s
        break
carry_to(best_spot["x"], best_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=1.329 + (1.329 - best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]))
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
